title: Publish Live Editor previews for the `develop` & `next` branches
body:
Adds links to https://develop.git.mermaid.live and https://next.git.mermaid.live

The site is published using the branch deploy feature of netlify to publish a live editor clone with mermaid compiled from the respective branch.
author: sidharthv96

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Just to clarify, is the `https://beta.mermaid.live` the latest `beta`/`rc` pre-released versions pushed to NPM (viewable at https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid?activeTab=versions)?

If so, please change this documentation to say the `Try the latest beta changes before an official release` (does this mean that `-alpha` NPM builds won't show up in `beta.mermaid.live`)

---

If the `https://beta.mermaid.live` app is actually the latest commit on the `develop` branch, I'd recommend renaming it to something like `git-develop.mermaid.live`, just to make it clear what it is!

If possible, it would be super cool if `mermaid.live`'s version number had a git hash in it too, e.g. something like:

![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/19716675/63c7c233-b6e7-4a60-a61b-18700ea7fb7b)

Just to make it obvious which commit the `<insert-name-here>.mermaid.live` site was built-on, and to make it easier to debug if the site is still updating.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
The commit hash in version is something I had 'half-implemented' a while back in LE. 
Currently, the version numbers would mostly be wrong, as we don't update the number in the develop branch.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
> Currently, the version numbers would mostly be wrong, as we don't update the number in the develop branch.

:+1: It would be nice to have the commit hash, or maybe a warning saying that this is a development version, but that can be future work!

If you change the URL to `develop.git.mermaid.live` (or `git-develop.mermaid.live` if it's too many subdomains for your `*.mermaid.live` SSL certificate) and change the name to **Live Editor - Git `develop` preview** (or a similar name), I'd be happy for this PR to be merged.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment requests documentation changes, a potential rename of the subdomain (e.g., to 'git-develop.mermaid.live'), and suggests adding a git hash to the version number displayed on the site — all concrete suggested improvements.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
```suggestion
        There is a chance that the bug is already fixed in the git `develop` branch, but is not released yet. 
```

Minor change, we probably shouldn't call the `develop`/`next` branches the "latest version", since they're not yet released.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment includes an explicit code suggestion block with a specific wording change to the bug report template.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body: Is there any way to make this more obvious that these live editors are previews of the unreleased git `develop`/`next` branch? Maybe something like: ```suggestion Try Live Editor previews of future releases: Develop | Next ```

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Initially, I didn't want to make it too long. Added now.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment includes an explicit code suggestion block proposing rewording and new URLs in the README to better communicate that the live editors are previews of unreleased branches.
